description: This file defines a React component for a settings page of a web application, including functionalities for managing logging callbacks, alert configurations, callback creation/editing/deletion, and related UI elements.

classes.name: DynamicParamsFields
classes.description: A React functional component that displays dynamic input fields based on parameters and callback configuration, used in callback creation/edit dialogs.

classes.name: CallbackSelector
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a dropdown for selecting callback configurations, showing logo and display name.

methods.name: getDynamicParamsForCallback
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve dynamic parameters for a given callback name from the callback configurations.

methods.name: buildCallbackPayload
methods.description: Helper function that constructs the payload object for callback registration/update based on form values.
